Hi Samantha and Tom,

Thanks again for taking the time today — good conversation. Quick recap and the asks we discussed so we can keep momentum: 

Call recap:
- Primary use case: real-time inference for fraud-detection scoring at low latency (~75ms p95).
- Expected Q2 pilot: ~5M tokens/day initially, scale to 25M tokens/day on successful pilot.
- Technical and security reviewers: Samantha (security/engineering), Tom (economic buyer/Head of Product), procurement for contractual/PO steps.

Open items / next asks:
1) Procurement process & PO: who is the procurement contact and what are the standard PO terms (billing cadence, remit-to, net terms)?
2) Vendor onboarding: any required vendor forms, W-9, security questionnaires or onboarding docs we should fill out?
3) Decision timeline: confirm target decision date and any required approvals from Legal/Security.
4) Billing contact & email for invoice/PO submission.

We'll prepare a short SOW and draft invoice and can send via DocuSign or your preferred procurement portal once we have the billing contact and PO process. I've looped in Nikhil (solutions engineer) who will provide the SOW and vendor onboarding attachments.

Proposed next steps:
- Samantha: share procurement contact and any vendor onboarding checklist (by EOD Fri 3/13).
- Acme: confirm PO terms / net terms or if a credit card/billing account should be used for pilot.
- Redwood: send SOW + vendor_onboarding_form.xlsx and sample invoice for internal review.

Thanks —

Hi Marissa —

Thanks for the recap. Quick answers inline: 

- Economic buyer: Tom Briggs (Head of Product) — he will sign off on spend > $25k.
- Procurement contact for onboarding & PO issuance: procurement@acme-fintech.com (procurement team lead is Carla Mendoza).
- Security requirements: we require a SOC 2 Type II attestation and a completed vendor security questionnaire. Our security team will also want to review data retention and audit-log behavior (they usually ask for an architecture diagram).
- Timeline: target decision by 2026-03-26; procurement has a 1-2 week turnaround once legal/compliance sign-off is complete.

On the vendor onboarding forms: please send your standard vendor_onboarding_form.xlsx and a draft SOW/invoice. I'll route them to procurement and legal. If you can also include the SOC 2 report link (or a letter from your security/compliance team), that speeds review.

Forwarding your note to procurement@acme-fintech.com now.

Best,
Samantha
Senior Security Program Manager
Acme Fintech
